mentions.name: TheInstant.cc cycling tools
mentions.description: This is a portfolio of free-to-use cycling related tools, including a route weather planner and a gel recipe tool. It grew out of tools the author wished existed while training, building bikes, or planning, and new tools are added as ideas and personal needs arise.
mentions.problem: The author lacked free tools for cycling training, bike building, and ride planning.
mentions.audience: Cyclists who train, build bikes, and plan rides
mentions.source_excerpt:
In my spare time, I’ve been working on a portfolio of cycling related tools, all free to use. These are things I wish I had when training, building bikes, or planning.

https://theinstant.cc/

So far, I’ve been getting pretty good feedback on the route weather planner and the gel recipe.
